differences.title: 1. Core Abstraction
differences.leftDesc: Prefect uses Python functions as Tasks, grouped into Flows, focusing on robust execution and state management with dynamic retries and caching.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster defines data assets and computations (Ops) orchestrated into jobs, emphasizing data lineage and asset management for end-to-end pipelines.

differences.title: 2. Data Awareness
differences.leftDesc: Prefect passes results between tasks using its built-in serialization, offering flexibility but less inherent data lineage tracking.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster explicitly models data assets, enabling rich lineage, versioning, and type checking directly within the orchestration layer.

differences.title: 3. Execution Model
differences.leftDesc: Prefect's dynamic graph execution allows for on-the-fly task generation and conditional logic, making it highly adaptable to changing conditions.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster builds a static computation graph from Ops and Assets, providing strong guarantees about execution and dependencies before runtime.

differences.title: 4. UI & Observability
differences.leftDesc: Prefect offers a centralized UI for monitoring runs, logs, and deployments, with Prefect Cloud providing SaaS orchestration.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster's UI visualizes data assets, lineage, and job runs, offering deep insights into pipeline health and data dependencies.

differences.title: 5. Deployment
differences.leftDesc: Prefect uses agents to poll the API for work, allowing flexible deployment configurations across various infrastructures.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster deployments manage jobs and schedules, often integrated with CI/CD, providing a structured way to release pipelines.

differences.title: 6. Testing
differences.leftDesc: Prefect supports testing individual tasks and entire flows programmatically, ensuring components function as expected.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster emphasizes testing data assets and job computations, integrating testing into the data pipeline development lifecycle.

differences.title: 7. Ecosystem & Philosophy
differences.leftDesc: Prefect aims to make Python workflows robust, flexible, and easy to manage, with a strong focus on developer experience.
differences.rightDesc: Dagster prioritizes data quality and lineage, viewing orchestration as a tool to manage and understand data pipelines holistically.
